''See also: [[Cormac Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Cormac is a [[Traveler]] of [[Endross]], a territory characterized by its brutal desert landscapes and violent storms. Serving under [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]], he possesses terrifying abilities, including the power to manipulate thunderstorms and hold swirling masses of lightning within his hands. He is described as having poisonous green eyes and a bald head. Cormac is known for his instability and cruelty; he was responsible for the death of [[Simon's mother]] and harbors a deep hatred for [[Damasca]]. While acting as a legally appointed representative of [[Damasca]], his behavior has been characterized as insane. Despite his volatile nature, he maintains control over his powers and possesses significant durability, having survived being thrown a great distance.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Cormac serves [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]] and was his only [[Endross]]. He victimized [[Orlina]], captured [[Leah]], and killed the mother of [[Simon]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|House of Blades}} ===
